question: Sardar Sarovar Dam stands on which river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sardar Sarovar Dam is a massive dam built on the **Narmada River** in the Indian state of Gujarat.
 
• It's one of the largest dams in India and is a crucial part of the Narmada Valley Development Project.
 
• It is a multipurpose dam, primarily designed to provide irrigation water to the arid regions of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Rajasthan.
 
• It also generates hydroelectric power.
 
• It is one of the largest dams in India and is considered a significant engineering feat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna River:** This river flows primarily through the states of Maharashtra and Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• **Godavari River:** This river flows through the states of Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Odisha.
